proves.claim: The stale workflow closes only inactive clarify issues and never modifies PRs.

github.workflows.stale-closes-inactive-o.why: The stale workflow closed active issues or modified pull requests.

proves.claim: Only the issue author reopens a closed clarify issue and clears its label.

github.workflows.author-reopens.why: A non-author could reopen a clarify issue.

proves.claim: Non-authors, pull requests, reopened issues, and missing clarify labels do not change state.

github.workflows.non-author-no-change.why: Non-authors, pull requests or unlabeled issues changed state.

proves.claim: The stale script closes an issue quiet for fourteen days and leaves active issues and PRs alone.

github.workflows.stale-fourteen-days.why: The stale script closed an active issue or one quiet under fourteen days.

proves.claim: GitHub front door preserves every exact provider binding.

github.snapshot.provider-bindings.why: The GitHub front door dropped an exact provider binding.

proves.claim: The broader GitHub barrel cannot masquerade as the CI observation module.

github.snapshot.barrel-not-ci-module.why: The broader barrel passed as the CI observation module.

proves.claim: every github-cell test registered here has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

github.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: Every test file in packages/github/tests that reads repo files carries an input header naming the cells it reads.

github.inputs.every-github-test-file-rea.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: With the declared-inputs rule on, no github-cell test reads fixtures, data or docs without a header.

github.inputs.with-the-declared-inputs-r.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: The real and fake GitHub request adapters both return { status, body } for a GET of one repository path.

github.request.get-one-repository-path.why: The fake adapter drifted from the real one, so a test through it proves nothing about GitHub.

proves.claim: Both GitHub request adapters refuse a path without a leading slash with the same named refusal.

github.request.refuse-a-path-without-a-s.why: One form accepted a relative path the other refuses.

proves.claim: The real and fake npm adapters both answer ci with { code, stderr }, the real form running npm ci --cache in dir.

github.io-adapter-npm.ci-answers-code-an.why: The fake adapter drifted from the real one, so a test through it proves nothing about npm.

proves.claim: Both npm adapters refuse a relative dir or a missing cache with the same named refusal.

github.io-adapter-npm.refuse-bad-input.why: One form accepted input the other refuses.

proves.claim: createGithubAdapter requests the base it is given instead of api.github.com.

github.io-adapter-request.base-requests-.why: A caller-supplied base was ignored and requests went to api.github.com.

proves.claim: The GitHub adapter accepts only an https base or a loopback http base and refuses any other by name.

github.io-adapter-request.base-accepts-o.why: A plain-http remote base was accepted and sent requests unencrypted.

proves.claim: A caller signal passed to the real GitHub adapter reaches its fetch.

github.io-adapter-request.base-forwards-.why: A caller could not cancel a hung GitHub request.

proves.claim: Both adapter forms, imported from the github front door, pass the contract table.

github.io-adapter-request.base-front-doo.why: The front door exported a form that drifted from the contract.

proves.claim: request(path, { method, headers, body, signal }) reaches fetch with redirect manual and the response gives { status, headers, body } with the Link header readable.

github.io-adapter-request.method-sends-m.why: Without it callers that POST or page by Link header have no contract to rely on.

proves.claim: A response body is parsed as JSON only when its content type says json, else it is text.

github.io-adapter-request.method-body-pa.why: Without it a form-encoded response would throw in a JSON parse.

proves.claim: The fake adapter answers the same contract table keyed by method and path, and a GET with no options answers from the bare path.

github.io-adapter-request.method-fake-an.why: Without it the fake could drift from the real form once methods exist.

proves.claim: Both npm adapter forms, imported from the github front door, pass the contract table.

github.io-adapter-npm.front-door-passes-.why: The front door exported a form that drifted from the contract.

proves.claim: githubKeys reads users/<login>/keys through the GitHub adapter from the PULLBOARD_GITHUB_API base and returns only well-formed SSH keys.

github.io-adapter-keys.reads-well-formed.why: A malformed or unsupported key was handed to a member's device, or the read went to the wrong base.

proves.claim: githubKeys refuses a non-2xx answer, a redirect, a non-loopback http base and a request over 10 s as GITHUB_UNAVAILABLE.

github.io-adapter-keys.refuses-unavailab.why: An unavailable GitHub read looked like an account with no keys, or hung without a limit.

proves.claim: The pull request's commits and comments load through the GitHub adapter in the gate's shape across pages of 100, and a fixture file answers live false with no request.

github.io-cla.loads-commits-and-comments.why: Without it the moved network half could drift from the shape the gate's evaluator reads.

proves.claim: A non-ok page from the GitHub adapter makes the pull request load throw the API status for the requested path.

github.io-cla.load-throws-the-status-of-.why: Without it a failing page could load as an empty list and the gate would judge a pull request on partial data.

proves.claim: The CLA status posts to the PR head through the adapter with state, context CLA and a 140 character description, and a refused or throwing post never throws.

github.io-cla.posts-the-status-through-t.why: Without it the check could hide its exit code behind a failed post, or post nothing.

proves.claim: runCla calls the injected evaluate and readSignatures, imports nothing from gate, exits 0 for a signed author and 1 for an unsigned one on fixture files, and posts the status.

github.io-cla.runs-with-injected-pure-ha.why: Without it the check could bind to gate again or report the wrong exit code.
